workflow: A build configuration selects a platform and feature combination that omits the full definition of an optional runtime state type.
A refactor moves a reference to that state into shared declarations without preserving the configuration guard.
The affected compilation path encounters an unconditional reference to a type that was never defined for that configuration.
Compilation fails with a missing-type error instead of using a neutral placeholder definition or conditionally omitting the reference.
summary: Configuration-guard mismatch exposes an undefined optional state type
